newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek depos, bonds, forwards idle, ecu/drs ranges.
newsitem.headline: Greek depos, bonds, forwards idle, ecu/drs ranges.

text.p: Greek interbank depos, forex forwards and bonds were little changed in early quiet dealings and ecu/drachma was slightly lower at 304.83/88, dealers said.

"There is limited trading activity and rates are unmoved," said a dealer at a private bank. "I think it is going to continue like this for a while unless the central bank cuts its overnight bid or a series of auctions of government bonds alter liquidity."

Bank of Greece kept its overnight bid unchanged at 12.40 percent on Friday although January's revised CPI inflation fell to 6.8 percent year-on-year from 7.3 percent in December. It dropped to 7.1 percent in January from 7.5 percent in December based on the old CPI index.

But an economist at a foreign bank noted that core inflation, which does not include volatile food and energy prices, shot up to 8.7 percent in January from 8.2 in December based on old CPI calculations.
No core inflation figures were available for the revised CPI index.
Secondary trading on taxable state debt paper had come to a standstill because of unresolved tax issues, dealers said.
The finance ministry is expected to unveil its tax rules this week.
Prices on tax-free securities were oscillating in narrow bands around current levels.
The mark was quoted at 156.88/98 drachmas from Friday's 156.880 fix, the dollar at 262.24/34 drachmas from 260.860 and the Ecu at 304.76/86 from 304.950 drachmas.
"It is quiet. Ecu/drachma trades around 304.83/88," said a forex trader at a foreign bank.
